item.title: Kansas disregards CDC vaccine changes, will trust scientific evidence instead

item.title: Kansas legislators hear divided testimony on proposed school cellphone ban
item.description: A bipartisan Kansas bill that aims to implement a bell-to-bell cellphone ban beginning next school year would override local rules and establish one of the nation’s most restrictive policies. Continue reading ...

item.title: New lawsuit challenges City of Lawrence’s housing discrimination ordinance
item.description: A real estate company has filed a federal lawsuit against the City of Lawrence challenging an ordinance that bans discrimination based on where a potential tenant's rent payments would come from, such as housing vouchers. Continue reading ...

item.title: Who can represent Kansas in court? Governor and attorney general clash at Supreme Court
item.description: The Kansas Supreme Court is considering who can represent the state in court, after Democratic Gov. Laura Kelly and Republican Attorney General Kris Kobach have clashed over taking legal action on behalf of the state. Continue reading ...
